inputs.source: Published HR policy index content, authored by HR content team, two-person review required to publish

instructions.note: "Do not give legal advice" is enforced only by instruction; no structural control prevents the model from framing advice as policy interpretation.

controls.name: Least-privilege read-only credential scoped to policy index
controls.decay_rationale: Does not decay with model capability; the agent cannot perform write, delete, execute, spend, or configure actions it holds no credential for, regardless of how it is prompted.

controls.name: Network egress denied at network layer, verified by pen test
controls.decay_rationale: Enforced at the network layer outside the model and verified by pen test, so it does not rely on model compliance. A new tool or MCP server could introduce an egress channel this control does not cover.

controls.name: Chat reply destination bound to the authenticated requester's own session
controls.decay_rationale: The destination comes from the authenticated session record, not from model output, so it does not decay with model capability. Only defeated if ownership removes or bypasses this binding (control_removal).

controls.name: Chat client does not render images or auto-fetch links
controls.decay_rationale: Enforced client-side outside the model; blocks common markdown/image-based side-channel exfiltration regardless of model behavior.

controls.name: Two-person review required to publish policy content
controls.decay_rationale: Enforced by organizational process outside the model, but can be bypassed by insider collusion, process relaxation, or by merging content from a source this process does not cover.

controls.name: Model pinned; upgrade requires a change ticket
controls.decay_rationale: Prevents silent model_upgrade; requires an explicit, reviewable change rather than an automatic swap.

controls.name: Prompt restricts the agent to published Acme HR policy Q&A
controls.decay_rationale: Relies on the model choosing to stay in scope; a more capable or adversarially prompted model can reason its way to exceptions.

controls.name: Prompt instructs the agent not to give legal advice
controls.decay_rationale: Purely behavioral; a more capable model can rationalize framing advice as policy interpretation rather than legal advice.

controls.name: Automated instruction/link-injection scanning of policy content before publish
controls.decay_rationale: Not currently implemented. A content classifier would reduce, but not eliminate, risk from adversarial phrasing in published policy text.

findings.title: Internal policy content delivered through a bound, egress-restricted reply channel

attack_path.note: Internal, HR-authored policy content enters the agent's context.
Agent reads the policy index with a read-only, least-privilege credential.
Agent sends quoted internal policy content out of the agent process to the chat client.

threat_refs.name: Exfiltration via AI Agent Tool Invocation

forecast.watch_signal: A new tool or output channel is added to tools.json (e.g., email, webhook, file export) that is not covered by the current destination-binding and no-egress controls, or the policy index is expanded to include individual, confidential HR records (data_scope_expansion).

evidence.observation: "Replies go only to the authenticated requester's chat session. The chat client does not render images or auto fetch links." This structurally binds the destination and closes common markdown/image exfiltration side channels.
"The agent has no other tools, no memory, and no network egress. Egress is denied at the network layer and has been verified by a pen test." No tool-initiated exfiltration path exists today.

Autonomy and runtime step/time limits are not stated numerically (max_unattended_steps and max_runtime_minutes are both null), which triggers the rubric's autonomy modifier on this S2 sink even though the architecture (one search, one reply) is practically single-step. This judgment call raises inherent risk from moderate to high; it would be removed if explicit limits were documented.

recommendations.action: Require a security and destination-binding review before any new tool, output channel, or MCP server is added to this agent, so the current no-egress guarantee is not silently lost when the tool set changes.

Declare and enforce explicit max_unattended_steps and max_runtime_minutes in runtime configuration, even though the current architecture is a single search-then-reply exchange, to remove reliance on the assessor's conservative default.

findings.title: Compromised or manipulated internal policy content could reach the employee as if it were trustworthy policy guidance

attack_path.note: Internal content, authored by HR content team under two-person review before publishing.
Agent retrieves and quotes this content.
Agent delivers the (possibly manipulated) content to the employee as apparent authoritative policy.

forecast.watch_signal: The two-person publish review is bypassed, automated away, or relaxed; or the policy index begins ingesting content from an external or uncurated feed without the same review (data_scope_expansion).

evidence.observation: "Only the HR content team can write to it, and publishing requires two person review." This is a preventive, structural control on the input, but it narrows rather than severs the path: it does not cover content from a future, unreviewed source, and does not stop the reply channel from delivering manipulated content to the legitimate employee (the destination-binding control covers exfiltration to an attacker-controlled destination, not content integrity, so it is not credited here).

"Use policy_search to find the relevant policy and quote it." The agent is designed to surface and quote retrieved text directly, so injected instructions or a misleading link embedded in a policy document would be reproduced largely as-is.
Autonomy modifier applied for the same reason as finding f1 (no stated max_unattended_steps/max_runtime_minutes), raising inherent from moderate to high.

recommendations.action: Add automated scanning of policy content for embedded instructions, suspicious links, or anomalous formatting as part of the publish pipeline, in addition to the existing two-person human review.
Render retrieved policy text to the model inside clearly delimited data tags, distinct from the system prompt, so injected text in a policy document is less likely to be parsed as an instruction.
Periodically audit a sample of agent replies against the underlying source policy text to detect drift or injected content the publish review missed.

rating.rationale: Both findings share the same chat_reply sink (is_egress true, internal data = S2) and the same internal-source policy content. Inherent risk is moderate by the base source/sink matrix (I x S2), but the rubric's autonomy modifier applies because the design does not state max_unattended_steps or max_runtime_minutes (both null satisfies the modifier condition), raising inherent to high for both findings; this is a documented judgment call that would be removed if the team specifies explicit step/runtime limits for this effectively single-turn search-then-reply agent. Residual drops sharply for f1 because the reply destination is structurally bound to the authenticated requester's own session and the chat client does not render links or images, severing the path to any attacker-controlled destination (residual: low); this credit does not apply to f2, since the risk there is content integrity/trust exploitation delivered to the legitimate recipient, not exfiltration, so only the narrowing two-person publish review control applies (residual: moderate). The forecast is dominated by f2: if the publish-review control is removed, bypassed, or not extended to a future unreviewed content source, the source effectively becomes untrusted and, combined with the same S2 sink and autonomy modifier, projects to critical. The single control whose decay moves the forecast most is ctrl.publish_review.

limitations: This assessment reflects the declared design and configuration described in the provided artifacts (prompt.md, tools.json, runtime notes), not observed runtime behavior.
No MCP configuration, IaC, or source code was provided; capability scope beyond policy_search.search is inferred from the runtime notes' claim of 'no other tools, no memory, and no network egress.'

max_unattended_steps and max_runtime_minutes are not specified; the rubric's conservative autonomy modifier was applied as a result, which is the single largest judgment call in this assessment and should be revisited once explicit limits are documented.

The rigor of the two-person publish review process (ctrl.publish_review) and the credential scoping claim were declared by the design, not independently verified by this assessment; confidence is scored medium to reflect that gap.
